chunks: "Whoever dies between the decline of the sun on Thursday and the decline of the sun on Friday will be safe from the squeezing of the grave."

key_terms.زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ: the sun’s decline from its midday position
key_terms.ضَغْطَةِ الْقَبْرِ: the squeezing or pressure of the grave in the intermediate realm after death
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, marking the end of the mentioned period
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْخَمِيسِ: Thursday, marking the beginning of the mentioned period

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for one who dies between Thursday noon and Friday noon according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that one who dies during the period from Thursday noon until Friday noon is granted safety from the pressure of the grave. The hadith concerns conditions of the afterlife and highlights the special merit associated with this time.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.372 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever dies between the decline of the sun on Thursday until the decline of the sun on will be safe from the squeezing (pressure) of the grave."
